subject: support_context

subject: restraint_filter
fresh_window_instruction: Design soft-penalty calibration before any hard veto or hard exclusion rule.
acceptance_test: Convert hard-exclusion evidence into soft-penalty simulations and test whether high-pressure rows can be downweighted without losing useful conversions.
pass_threshold: soft penalty must reduce FP pressure versus no-penalty reference while preserving materially useful positive conversions; hard veto is forbidden at this stage.
required_artifacts: Stage 6B replay/readback outputs plus Stage 6C/6D/6E workbench readbacks where applicable.

subject: broad_lineage_foundation_reference

acceptance_test: Retest narrowed lineage variants; do not promote broad lineage foundation directly.
pass_threshold: narrowed lineage must improve or preserve FP/yield versus primary while adding non-duplicate conversions.
required_artifacts: Stage 6B replay/readback outputs plus Stage 6C/6D/6E workbench readbacks where applicable.

subject: decay_watch_companion

subject: macro_findings_log

required_artifacts: Stage 6B replay/readback outputs plus Stage 6C/6D/6E workbench readbacks where applicable.
